name: faq-search
title: FAQ Search
description: A help-centre FAQ page with a live search box, underlined category tabs and a list of question rows that expand to reveal answers. Searching or filtering leaves either matching questions or a no-results state with a clear button.
use: A help centre needs a browsable, searchable list of questions that expand in place instead of separate pages.
avoid: The questions and answers are hardcoded in the file, with no deep links or pagination for a large knowledge base.
a11y: Accordion and tabs are keyboard reachable with good structure, but the search field relies on its placeholder for a name and reduced motion is not handled. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark help page with a large Frequently Asked Questions heading, a grey intro line and a small pill search field. A row of underlined category labels sits over a stack of rounded bordered question rows, each ending in a chevron; an open row reveals a muted paragraph, and a footer invites contact.
behaves: Typing in the search filters the questions live against titles and answers, and the category labels narrow the list to one topic with an underline on the active tab. Clicking a question expands its answer in place; when nothing matches, an empty state offers a Clear search button.
customise: There are no props: the questions, answers and categories are arrays inside the file, so content changes mean editing the source; colours follow the theme.
weight: light: A small list of questions with accordion transitions; no canvas or loops.
demo: Questions about creating a project, system requirements, collaboration, billing and bug reports.
issues: The category tabs have no tab role or aria-selected, so the active tab is visual only.
The search field has a placeholder but no visible or aria label.
polishWhy: Clean, well-spaced FAQ layout with working search; tab and search semantics are thin.
